details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof-of-concept that beacons the install back to a callback host. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, and its index.js module also triggers the same call when imported. The beacon POSTs a JSON body to hxxps://vmi3699893[.]contaboserver[.]net:8787/_ah/dc (self-signed TLS accepted) containing only install metadata: the package name, the machine hostname, the package install path, the working directory, the npm user the publisher, and the URL scheme, sent with an x-beacon-package header. It collects no environment variables, tokens, credential files, wallet data, or file contents, and drops no second stage. The package's README self-declares it as an authorized dependency-confusion test that only reports that it was installed.
